name: Histrelin
evidenceNote: Supprelin LA is approved for central precocious puberty on two open-label trials in 47 children that measured hormone suppression. Vantas was approved for advanced prostate cancer on a 138-man trial and is no longer made.
summary: Histrelin is a GnRH agonist delivered by a small implant in the upper arm for 12 months. It is FDA-approved to pause early puberty in children.
keyTakeaway: Histrelin is a synthetic, more potent version of the brain hormone GnRH. Delivered continuously from a small implant placed under the skin of the upper arm, it shuts down the pituitary signals that drive puberty and sex hormone production. As Supprelin LA it is FDA-approved for central precocious puberty in children aged 2 and older; in its pivotal trial, peak LH fell into the suppressed range within one month and stayed there for a year. A sister implant for prostate cancer, Vantas, was discontinued in 2021.

blocks.text: Histrelin is a synthetic nonapeptide (a chain of nine amino acids) modelled on gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH), the brain signal that tells the pituitary gland to release the reproductive hormones LH and FSH. It is more potent than the natural hormone [1].

What sets histrelin apart from other GnRH agonists is how it is given. Supprelin LA is a thin, flexible tube about 3.5 cm long containing 50 mg of histrelin acetate inside a hydrogel reservoir. Once placed under the skin, it releases about 65 mcg a day for 12 months, so a child needs no daily or monthly injections [1].

Natural GnRH arrives at the pituitary in pulses, and the pulses are what keep LH and FSH flowing. A steady, unbroken supply has the opposite effect. After a short initial burst of stimulation, the pituitary becomes desensitized, LH and FSH fall, and the ovaries or testes stop making much estrogen or testosterone [1].

That early burst is real and can be seen. In the first days, LH, FSH and sex hormones rise, and a child's puberty signs can briefly get worse or new ones appear [1]. In men with prostate cancer, testosterone climbed in the first week before dropping below the castrate threshold of 50 ng/dL by week 4 in a monitored subgroup [2]. In children, the label says sex hormone output is suppressed within four weeks and puberty signs then recede [1].

Yes. Supprelin LA, made by Endo, is approved and marketed for central precocious puberty [6]. The label records the first US approval of histrelin as 1991, when an injectable form came first; the yearly implant followed in 2007 [1][6].

items.text: Histrelin first approved in the United States [1].
Vantas, a 50 mg implant for advanced prostate cancer, is approved [5].
Supprelin LA is approved for central precocious puberty; the pivotal trial is published the same year [6][3].
After a manufacturing problem it could not fix, Endo tells FDA it has stopped making Vantas [4].
The Supprelin LA label adds a warning on severe skin reactions [1].

blocks.text: Drugs@FDA now lists Vantas as discontinued, while Supprelin LA remains a prescription product [5][6].

Supprelin LA treats central precocious puberty (CPP), meaning puberty that starts too early because the brain's GnRH system has switched on ahead of time: before age 8 in girls or 9 in boys [1]. Untreated, children with CPP often have a markedly advanced bone age, which can leave them shorter as adults [1]. The implant is not approved for children under 2, and the label suggests stopping around the age puberty would normally begin, roughly 11 for girls and 12 for boys [1]. While the implant is in, LH, FSH and sex hormones are checked one month after insertion and every six months after that, with height and bone age every 6 to 12 months [1].

The main trial enrolled 36 children (33 girls, 3 boys) at nine US centers, 20 of them new to treatment [3]. In the newly treated children, peak LH after a stimulation test fell from 28.2 to 0.8 mIU/mL within one month, estradiol dropped from 24.5 to 5.9 pg/mL, and suppression held for the full year [3].

rows: All newly treated children by month 1, maintained to month 12 [1]
Suppression maintained in all three previously treated boys [1]

blocks.text: Vantas used the same 50 mg design at a slightly lower release rate for palliative treatment of advanced prostate cancer, meaning to control the disease rather than cure it [2]. Before it was discontinued it cost roughly a ninth of Supprelin LA, and some doctors used it off label for early puberty to spare families the higher price [4].

Most problems come from the implant procedure. In the two pediatric trials, 51.1% of the 47 children had an implant site reaction, such as bruising, soreness, swelling or itching, and about 6% each had keloid or other scarring or a stitch problem [1]. Implants have broken during removal, and placing the implant too deep makes it harder to find and take out [1].

items: A temporary worsening of puberty signs, or new ones, in the first week or so while hormones briefly rise [1].
Mood changes, including crying, irritability and aggression, and rare reports of depression with suicidal thoughts in children on GnRH agonists [1].
Seizures, mostly in children with a history of seizures or other risk factors [1].
Pseudotumor cerebri (raised pressure around the brain), signalled by headache and vision changes [1].
Severe skin reactions such as Stevens-Johnson syndrome, added to the label in 2025 [1].

blocks.text: In men treated with Vantas for prostate cancer, the profile was that of testosterone loss: hot flashes affected 65.5% of trial patients [2].
